stem: A registered nurse provides clinical expertise to the state nurses association about a proposed regulation that would affect nursing practice. Which professional activity is this?
rationale: ANA describes nursing advocacy as participation in legislative and regulatory processes that influence health policy and nursing practice. Contributing professional expertise to a proposed regulation is regulatory advocacy.
educational_objective: Recognize nursing participation in legislative or regulatory policy development as professional advocacy.
source_document_title: Federal Nursing Issues — Advocacy & Getting Involved
source_locator: Advocacy / legislative and regulatory engagement by nurses and nursing organizations
source_claim_supported: Nurses may use professional expertise to influence legislation and regulation affecting nursing and health care.
blueprint_source_organization: National Council of State Boards of Nursing (NCSBN)
blueprint_locator: Management of Care, printed p.7/PDF p.11
correction_summary: Rebuilt the item around ANA's directly described legislative/regulatory advocacy rather than broad unsupported nurse-practice-act claims.
